assets.title: File:La Gombe, Kinshasa, RDC (cropped).jpg
assets.author: Francis Shok Mweze
assets.description: Gombe is a neighborhood situated in Kinshasa, which is the capital and largest city of the DRC. Gombe is known for its central location, government buildings, business quarters and picturesque views along the Congo River. It's an important administrative zone and commercial center for the residents of Kinshasa.
assets.review_note: Vue élevée de Gombe en 2023, utile pour la végétation et les volumes, pas pour mesurer les détails de façade.
